director.memo: Added 5 seats (14.5 pts) across five DIFFERENT drivers, taking the book to 17/20 seats and ~81% invested. Every FDA driver and the bio_convergence lane are full from the held book, so all new risk is deliberately non-bio: two Deal-completion adds (THRM antitrust spread at 5, ZYME as a 2% defined-risk Oct call spread after the board reclassified its Jazz-milestone catalyst out of the bio lane — a carried watchlist name graduating) bring that cluster to 36/40; three Idiosyncratic adds (DDL refi at 3 sized to its thin tape, LBTYK spin and LZM supply-timing at staging half-weights of 2.5 and 2 per their staging flags and the LBTYK skeptic's soft-floor cap) bring that cluster to 31.5/40. FDA/biotech stays at 13.5/40. Driver caps after adds: US_antitrust 2/2, Deal_close_generic 2/2, Refi_restructuring 2/2 — all at, none over. Risk-to-floor is 0.10-0.61% NAV per ratio name (max THRM 0.54) and the single binary carries exactly 2% premium-at-risk. The watchlist is a bio queue by construction: five clinical-readout binaries (EYPT first at +77% EV) and two approval-decision names stack up behind CELC/AMLX/VRDN/AQST resolutions, with CLVT ahead of MGNI for the first Forced_divest_flow seat — pending verification that today's unexplained +17% CLVT spike is not the catalyst firing.
